tools.name: get_aitvar_options
tools.description: Lists what Aitvar can make: the visual looks, video lengths, narration languages, voices, music and tones that write_video_script accepts, and how Aitvar works. Needs no account.

tools.name: get_new_video_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the Aitvar website with the topic filled in, where the person can start the video themselves (they type their email there and read the script in about half a minute). Needs no account; use it when the person prefers the website or hasn’t connected their account.

tools.name: write_video_script
tools.description: Starts a new video draft in the person’s Aitvar account and has the AI write its script (scenes of narration with what is shown on screen, a title, caption and hashtags). Free. Usually takes 20-60 seconds; a long video can take longer, then call get_video later. Returns the video id and the script.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: Lists the videos in the person’s Aitvar account, newest first: drafts, videos being made and finished videos, with their ids and status.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Returns one video’s status, script, settings, cost and preview progress, and the link to its page in Aitvar, where the person watches and downloads it.

tools.name: update_video_script
tools.description: Changes a draft: replaces its script (title, scenes, caption, hashtags; give the whole scene list) and/or its look, length, voice, music or tone. Only drafts can change. Free.

tools.name: rewrite_video_script
tools.description: Has the AI rewrite a draft’s script following an instruction, e.g. "make the hook punchier" or "add the 1969 study". Free, a limited number of times per draft.

tools.name: make_free_preview
tools.description: Renders the draft as it is now so the person can watch it before paying: the first 5 seconds in about 2 minutes, the whole video in about 6, on the video’s page. Free (an account has a few free previews until it buys videos; a draft can be previewed again after edits a few times).

tools.name: approve_video
tools.description: Approves a draft and makes the final video, using videos from the person’s Aitvar balance (the cost is in get_video as cost_in_videos). Only call this after the person has seen the script and agreed to the cost. Pass that cost as expected_cost; nothing is charged if the price is higher.

tools.name: get_my_balance
tools.description: Returns how many videos are in the person’s Aitvar balance and how many free previews the account has left.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_new_video_link · Public sink: get_new_video_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_new_video_link · Public sink: get_new_video_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
